doctrine: Three templates + one AGENT override. Same IA renders twice — human eye + agent parser.

trinity_tile_page.name: trinity-tile-page
anatomy: trinity_tile_row (3 cards: HUMAN · INSTITUTION · EARTH, AAA bridge centered)
toroidal_anchor: trinity_ring (around AAA bridge on home and scope pages)

organ_page.name: organ-page
anatomy: organ_card grid (1+ cards, each with port + status dot)
MCP affordance (button-ghost: 'MCP for this surface' → calls forge_* tools on agent side)
epistemic_label strip (OBS · DER · INT · SPEC — visible on hover for human, always visible for agent)
organ_page.toroidal_use: trinity_ring (sits at top of organ card grid) OR none (if a flat-surface mission-driven layout is chosen)

surface_page.name: surface-page
anatomy: body (long-form content; serif for doctrine, sans for human, mono for machine)
prev_next_nav (within the surface or to the next surface)
surface_page.toroidal_use: mission_wheel (on /missions only) OR none (for doctrinal or article pages)

agent_overrides.name: agent-surface.html
agent_overrides.use: Same IA, AGENT render mode. Server-side via User-Agent detection OR explicit /mcp/ JSON path.
agent_overrides.type: Plex Mono only, no sans/serif (unless explicitly in body content)
agent_overrides.chrome: hairline rules, no shadows, no transforms (tactile removed)
agent_overrides.feedback: status badges (SEAL/HOLD/VOID) — no tactile lift, color shift only on hover
agent_overrides.density: tight (16-24px between blocks); tables preferred over cards; JSON blocks preferred over prose
agent_overrides.epistemic_labels: always visible as prefix tags (kernel: OBS/DER/INT/SPEC; wealth: CLAIM/PLAUSIBLE/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN)
agent_overrides.header: scope name + version + last-updated ISO timestamp, monospace
agent_overrides.footer: monospace: vault:999  sealed:3847  last:2026-08-01T06:51Z  kernel:kanon-kanon-2026.07.31+0b03b5b  doctrine:v2.2
agent_overrides.mcp_affordance: every organ card has 'MCP for this surface' button-ghost that calls forge_* tools
agent_overrides.json_ld: prominent in <head> AND inline at top of body for parseability

frame_components.sovereign_strip: 32px sticky, --blue-900, F13 status + actor + version + shortcut hint
frame_components.trinity_tile_row: 1fr 1fr 1fr grid, 16px gap, max-width 960px, AAA bridge centered between tiles
frame_components.breadcrumb: mono 12px, › separator at 40% opacity, generated from URL path
frame_components.prev_next_nav: two-column footer block, mono 12px, translateX(2px) on hover
frame_components.mission_footer: VAULT999 + last-sealed + doctrine version + kernel build hash

build_pipeline.schema_validation: JSON Schema via canon/public-state.schema.json (block build on violation)
